title: Digital Navigation Laboratory opened
summary: The new facility combines ECDIS simulators, route modelling and research in intelligent transport systems.

body.text: A digital navigation laboratory has opened at the university. It supports cadet training and applied research in intelligent transport systems.

items: Workstations for vessel traffic data analysis.

body.text: The laboratory is used in navigation and water transport management programmes and in joint projects with industry partners.
